parameters.content:
## COMPLETE PRODUCT CATALOG SYNC
Runs every six hours in Europe/London time. Shopify is authoritative. Each successful run performs a full catalog scan, upserts product, variant, cost and location inventory details, preserves product-title history, and soft-deletes records no longer present in Shopify. The final checkpoint advances only after every page and deletion finalization succeeds.
